messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test? Maybe they want the standard error? Or the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under null? Or maybe they want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean? That would be sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40) ≈ 6.3249. 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2213. So standard error ~0.2213.

But the user might want to compute the p-value for a t-test? They mention "零假設檢定的標準差" which could be the standard deviation of the null distribution? Actually the null hypothesis is that population mean = 98.6. They want to test sample mean 98.2 vs population mean 98.6. They might want to compute the t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / (1.4 / sqrt(40)) = (-0.4) / 0.2213 = -1.807. Then compute p-value. But the user didn't ask for p-value explicitly. They asked: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" That is ambiguous. They might want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean under the null hypothesis. That is the standard error. So answer: 0.2213.

Alternatively, they might want to compute the standard deviation of the null distribution of the test statistic? That would be sqrt((n-1)/n) * sample_std_dev? Actually for t-test, the standard deviation of the t distribution is sqrt(n/(n-1)). But that's not typical.

Better to ask clarifying question: "您想要計算什麼？是樣本平均值的標準誤，還是t檢定的p值？" But the instruction says we should not ask clarifying questions. We should provide an answer. So we can interpret as computing the standard error of the mean. Provide that.

We can also mention the t-statistic and p-value. But the user didn't ask for p-value. But we can provide both for completeness.

Thus answer: Standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40) ≈ 0.221. t-statistic = (98.2-98.6)/0.221 ≈ -1.81. Two-tailed p-value ≈ 0.078. But we can compute precisely: t = -1.807. df = 39. p-value two-tailed: using t distribution. Let's approximate: For df=39, t=1.807, p ≈ 0.079. So p ~ 0.079. So we can say that.

Thus answer: Standard error ~0.221. If you want p-value: ~0.079. Provide explanation.
